consideredAndDeclined: Charging the absence of an explicit 'Commit: C-D328' limb. Declined: the D-323 and D-327 turn-1 drafts carry the overturn token in the Reversibility limb and acquire the Commit limb only at adoption, which is the same shape here.

Charging the Subject limb for reciting 'leftoverDesign remains [OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING]' when the successor has no top-level leftoverDesign key. Declined: the key exists at $.summary.leftoverDesign with exactly that one-element value, the draft's bracket notation matches the JSON list form, and the D-323 precedent recited the same field the same way.

Charging the draft for not reciting the text of Codex's single observationsNotFindings string. Declined: the draft counts it, marks the Codex identifier standing 'none', and states that Codex returned no observation identifiers. D-327 handled twelve such strings identically. Reciting the text would risk promoting a non-finding into apparent finding status.

Charging 'Not a required-now successor' as unsupported. Declined: required-now is 28 at live file 08 and the successor's requiredNowUnchanged is 28; the entry adds no DR-G* row, so it is by construction not a required-now successor.

Declined: the dispatch's constraint is that the entry must not SATISFY them, and the caveat block disclaims all four of DR-117, DR-125, DR-131 and DR-133 explicitly. The Decision limb repeats the three that bear on G20 lineage, which is the D-323 shape.

Charging the Readiness-effect limb's '28 of 28' as a naming-half claim the entry cannot make. Declined: the limb says condition 4 'stays MET', asserts zero condition-4 effect, and live file 08 already reads 28 of 28 MET. The entry moves nothing.
consentRule: CONSENT requires zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX. Both rosters are empty, so CONSENT is compelled by the rule rather than chosen.
scopeOfConsent: Consent is to recording g20 leftover-join.v11 as the G20 leftover remasurement after D-327, on the terms the draft states: binds NOTHING, DR-G20 stays OPEN, no row SATISFIED, leftover-design of OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING remains open pending a paired successor on sdk leftover-join.v6, required-now stays 28, file 08 untouched. Consent extends to no other act, and to no version of the draft other than the bytes digesting to 6dcfa43faaebdc3fffded73b4770c8ce7262abfeca8c4b4a32f533260cf8ee9b.
independence: This review was produced without reading the other reviewer's current-turn D-328 review. That file was observed to exist on disk during the pre-write custody check and was deliberately not opened. No coordination of any kind occurred on this turn.
writeDiscipline: Wrote exactly one file: docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-328.review-adversarial.claude2.json. Did not edit the subject. Did not edit file 08. Did not edit COORD. Did not commit. Did not mark any row SATISFIED. Did not close leftover-design of OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING. Did not record any g20 leftover-join version as current. Did not touch sdk leftover-join.v6 or OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED. Did not touch any D-319 draft. Invented no identifier.
verdictStatement: CONSENT. 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. All fifteen digest assertions recompute from disk; both Stage A return shapes match a strict parse clause for clause, including the Codex shape change that the draft correctly records rather than carrying forward; every heading, status token and readiness number the draft recites is live; all seventeen dispatched attacks and ten additional attacks are refuted against bytes. The four observations travel as honesty work and bar nothing.
